name: ⛏️ My Anime Mine
desc:
My Anime Mine is a unique incremental game. Multiply your crew's damage by leveling them up, mutating them and enchanting them!

⛏️ Your Anime Characters break rocks for ores
💪 Level Up your crew's damage
🎲 Roll OP Enchantments
🪄 Summon Limited Characters
⌛ Upgrade the Research Tree to unlock the next mining zone!

🔁 Player Trading unlocks in the last zone!
